# Data Lakehouse Architecture – Pipeline & Governance

## Overview
This dataset describes a modern data lakehouse architecture following the medallion pattern (Bronze → Silver → Gold). It captures 10 data sources across 5 categories, 3 ingestion modes, 5 medallion-layer datasets per tier, 6 consumption endpoints, 15 governance controls, and transformation summaries per layer.

## Data Source

### architecture_nodes
Each record represents a component in the architecture. Fields: `node_id` (string, unique identifier), `label` (display name), `layer` (one of: source, ingestion, bronze, silver, gold, consumption), `category` (grouping within layer), `daily_volume_gb` (numeric or null for consumption nodes), `format` (data format or technology). 34 nodes total.

### architecture_edges
Directed edges between nodes. Fields: `edge_id` (string), `source` and `target` (node_id references), `volume_gb` (numeric or null), `mode` (streaming | batch | cdc | query), `latency` (descriptive string). 38 edges total.

### governance_controls
Governance policies applied per layer. Fields: `control_id`, `layer` (architecture layer or cross-layer), `control_type`, `tool`, `scope`, `enforcement` (automated | policy-based | manual | scheduled). 15 records.

### transformation_summary
Counts of transformation types per medallion layer. Fields: `layer`, `transformation_type`, `count` (integer), `complexity` (low | medium | high). 12 records across bronze, silver, and gold.

## Data Notes
- Volume figures are illustrative daily averages; actual volumes vary by day.
- Some bronze volumes exceed source totals due to log fan-out and metadata enrichment.
- Consumption-layer nodes have null volume as they represent query-based access.
- Governance controls tagged as "cross-layer" apply to the entire pipeline.---

gov = data['governance_controls']['data']

# Focus on required story: 5 source categories -> ingestion -> bronze/silver/gold -> consumption
source_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['layer']=='source']
source_cat_volume = defaultdict(float)
for n in source_nodes:
    source_cat_volume[n['category']] += n['daily_volume_gb']

ingestion_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['layer']=='ingestion']
medallion_nodes = {layer:[n for n in nodes if n['layer']==layer] for layer in ['bronze','silver','gold']}
cons_nodes = [n for n in nodes if n['layer']=='consumption']

# Aggregate edge volumes by layer transitions
pairs = [
    ('source','ingestion'),
    ('ingestion','bronze'),
    ('bronze','silver'),
    ('silver','gold'),
    ('gold','consumption'),
]

layer_flow = defaultdict(float)
for e in edges:
    s = nodes_by_id[e['source']]['layer']
    t = nodes_by_id[e['target']]['layer']
    v = e['volume_gb'] if e['volume_gb'] is not None else 0
    if (s,t) in pairs:
        layer_flow[(s,t)] += v

# Gold fanout counts to consumption endpoints
fanout = defaultdict(int)
for e in edges:
    s = nodes_by_id[e['source']]['layer']
    t = nodes_by_id[e['target']]['layer']
    if s=='gold' and t=='consumption':
        fanout[nodes_by_id[e['target']]['label']] += 1

# Transformation counts per medallion layer
trans_counts = defaultdict(int)
for t in trans:
    trans_counts[t['layer']] += t['count']

# Governance counts by layer + cross-layer
gov_counts = defaultdict(int)
for g in gov:
    gov_counts[g['layer']] += 1

ax = plt.gca()
ax.set_xlim(0,1)
ax.set_ylim(0,1)
ax.axis('off')

# Business palette

    'source':'#4C78A8',
    'ingestion':'#72B7B2',
    'bronze':'#C9A66B',
    'silver':'#9AA3B2',
    'gold':'#E3BA22',
    'consumption':'#54A24B',
    'flow':'#4C78A8',
    'govern':'#B279A2',
    'text':'#1F2937',
    'muted':'#6B7280'
}

xpos = {
    'source':0.08,
    'ingestion':0.25,
    'bronze':0.42,
    'silver':0.56,
    'gold':0.70,
    'consumption':0.87,
}

# Draw stage boxes
for layer in ['source','ingestion','bronze','silver','gold','consumption']:
    x = xpos[layer]-0.06
    box = FancyBboxPatch((x,0.18),0.12,0.64, boxstyle='round,pad=0.01,rounding_size=0.01',
                         fc=colors[layer], ec='white', lw=1.5, alpha=0.18)
    ax.add_patch(box)
    label = layer.capitalize() if layer!='consumption' else 'BI/ML/API\nConsumption'
    ax.text(xpos[layer],0.84,label,ha='center',va='bottom',fontsize=12,fontweight='bold',color=colors['text'])

# Source category bars (volume)
sorted_cats = sorted(source_cat_volume.items(), key=lambda x:-x[1])
maxv = max(v for _,v in sorted_cats)
y0 = 0.72
for i,(cat,v) in enumerate(sorted_cats):
    y = y0 - i*0.105
    w = 0.1*(v/maxv)
    ax.add_patch(Rectangle((xpos['source']-0.05,y-0.02), w, 0.035, color=colors['source'], alpha=0.8))
    ax.text(xpos['source']-0.052, y-0.003, f"{cat}", ha='right', va='center', fontsize=9, color=colors['text'])
    ax.text(xpos['source']-0.05+w+0.005, y-0.003, f"{v:.0f} GB/day", ha='left', va='center', fontsize=9, color=colors['text'])

# Main throughput arrows between layers
maxflow = max(layer_flow.values()) if layer_flow else 1
for (s,t),v in layer_flow.items():
    if v<=0: continue
    y = 0.50
    lw = 2 + 16*(v/maxflow)
    arrow = FancyArrowPatch((xpos[s]+0.05,y),(xpos[t]-0.05,y),
                            arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=14,
                            lw=lw, color=colors['flow'], alpha=0.30,
                            connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.0')
    ax.add_patch(arrow)
    ax.text((xpos[s]+xpos[t])/2, y+0.045, f"{v:.0f} GB/day", ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=10, color=colors['text'], fontweight='bold')

# Medallion transformation callouts
for layer,yy in [('bronze',0.30),('silver',0.30),('gold',0.30)]:
    ax.text(xpos[layer], yy, f"Transformations: {trans_counts[layer]}", ha='center', va='center',
            fontsize=10, color=colors['text'], fontweight='bold')

# Gold fanout to endpoints
endpoint_y = [0.67,0.60,0.53,0.46,0.39,0.32]
for (label,count),y in zip(sorted(fanout.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1],x[0])), endpoint_y):
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((xpos['gold']+0.04,0.50),(xpos['consumption']-0.055,y),
                                 arrowstyle='-|>', mutation_scale=10,
                                 lw=1.3+count*0.45, color=colors['consumption'], alpha=0.6,
                                 connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.06'))
    ax.text(xpos['consumption']+0.005, y, f"{label} ({count} feeds)", ha='left', va='center',
            fontsize=9, color=colors['text'])

# Governance overlay band
band = FancyBboxPatch((0.04,0.10),0.92,0.06, boxstyle='round,pad=0.01,rounding_size=0.008',
                      fc=colors['govern'], ec=colors['govern'], alpha=0.16, lw=1.5)
ax.add_patch(band)
ax.text(0.5,0.13,
        f"Cross-Cutting Governance Overlay: {gov_counts['cross-layer']} controls (lineage, classification, compliance)  |  Layer controls: Ingestion {gov_counts['ingestion']}, Bronze {gov_counts['bronze']}, Silver {gov_counts['silver']}, Gold {gov_counts['gold']}, Consumption {gov_counts['consumption']}",
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=9.5, color=colors['text'], fontweight='bold')

# Legend
ax.text(0.05,0.93,'Legend', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold', color=colors['text'])
ax.plot([0.05,0.085],[0.905,0.905], lw=8, color=colors['flow'], alpha=0.3)
ax.text(0.09,0.905,'Flow width ∝ data volume (GB/day)', va='center', fontsize=9, color=colors['text'])
ax.plot([0.05,0.085],[0.88,0.88], lw=2.5, color=colors['consumption'], alpha=0.6)
ax.text(0.09,0.88,'Gold fan-out links to endpoints', va='center', fontsize=9, color=colors['text'])

# Title/subtitle
fig.suptitle('Lakehouse End-to-End Data Flow: Sources → Medallion Layers → BI/ML/API Consumption',
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', color=colors['text'], y=0.98)
ax.text(0.5,0.945,
        'Daily throughput by stage transition, transformation intensity per medallion layer, and governance controls spanning the pipeline',
        ha='center', va='center', fontsize=10.5, color=colors['muted'])

plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.95])
plt.savefig('/app/output/result.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
